Common questions

How often should my lawn be mowed?

Fortnightly through spring and summer suits most lawns; monthly is usually enough in winter. Choose what suits you on the quote form.

How much does a mow cost?

A standard mow is $55–70 for a small lawn (under 150m²), $75–95 for a medium lawn (150–400m²) and $105–140 for a large lawn (400–800m²). Anything bigger is quoted individually. If you would rather not think about it, the monthly subscription is a flat $85.

Do I need to be home?

Not if there's street or side-gate access straight to the lawn — just leave a gate code or access notes on the quote form. If getting to the lawn means going through your garage or the house, you'll need to be home (or arrange access). Mention it when you request your quote so it's not a surprise on the day.

How do I pay?

Bank transfer. A deposit of $20 or 20% of the quoted price, whichever is higher, confirms your booking within 24 hours of accepting the quote. The rest is due on the day.

What if I'm not happy with the job?

Let us know within 24 hours of the mow and we'll make it right — usually by coming back to fix whatever's wrong. We don't offer refunds, but we won't leave a job half-done either.
